ana (community): opened a tiny backport PR for the ruby-sdk to align retry/backoff behavior with the go client — CI is failing on macos-arm in the matrix. anyone seen native ext build woes on m1?

trent: link? macos-arm trips up native builds often. what error are you getting?

ana (community): https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/58 
build log shows: `ld: library not found for -lssl` during gem native extension compile step. full snippet: ```compiling openssl.c
/Applications/Xcode.../ld: library not found for -lssl
make: *** [openssl.so] Error 1```

ryan: saw this before — on mac arm openssl from homebrew isn't linked into system paths. CI linux runners have openssl dev libs preinstalled, so they pass.

trent: two ways: 1) teach CI to brew install openssl@1.1 and set LDFLAGS/CPPFLAGS before gem install; or 2) avoid compiling the extension on platform when not strictly needed (use a pure-ruby fallback).

ana (community): local quickfix worked: `export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib" CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include"` then `bundle install`. but that's rough for first-time contributors.

ryan: i'd prefer adding macos-arm to our CI matrix and a brew step. also add a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about M1 dev setup. small PR change to .github/workflows should unblock this backport.

ana (community): ok i'll update PR 58 with a workflow tweak (add macos-arm64 runner + `brew install openssl@1.1` step) and a CONTRIBUTING note. tagging @trent for quick review after tests.

ci-bot: PR 58  checks failed (macos-arm64) at 2002345690

trent: thanks. if it's just CI infra and docs i'll approve once green. long term we should evaluate removing native ext or making it optional to reduce onboarding friction.

ana (community): updated PR with CI matrix change and a short CONTRIBUTING section. kickstarted a workflow run.

ci-bot: workflow run passed for PR 58 at 2002345780 :white_check_mark:

trent: great, merging. thanks for the quick turnaround — that should reduce friction for community contributors on M1.

ci-bot: merged PR 58 into main at 2002345780
